FED HIKE ODDS SURGE

Markets now see a 70% chance of a September Fed rate hike, up from 37% last week.

Kalshi traders also favor a 25bp hike, as rising oil prices and inflation fears push Treasury yields higher.

Markets are increasingly betting the Fed will tighten again.
